case.summary: The cardholder C08106 reported a $128.33 online purchase on 2016-12-29 that they did not authorize. The transaction used a new device profile (Firefox 47.0) that had never been seen on this card before. The fraud model scored the transaction at 0.01 and the bank risk score was 0.34, both indicating low risk. Policy R2 advises blocking the card when the customer denies a transaction, and the exposure is below the $2,500 threshold for L1 approval. The case was therefore classified as fraud pending review.
